public interface INode
This interface is defined and implemented as a marker that the accept method is available and to ensure that subtypes implement the accept method.

Most implementations extend org.smtlib.impl.Pos.Printable, whose toString() delegates to the default Printer for debugger/IDE display only - never rely on toString() for program logic; use IPrinter/Printer explicitly for real output.
